title: The pipeline adopts the hand-made resources without replacing them
description:
```gherkin
Feature: Hand-made resources become pipeline stacks

  Scenario: The hosted zone is imported, not replaced
    Given the Route 53 zone for thehallucinator.ai exists and was made by hand
    And the registrar already holds its four name servers
    When the pipeline first deploys the DNS stack
    Then CloudFormation imports the zone into the stack
    And the change set shows Import and no Add, Modify or Remove of the zone
    And afterwards the zone's name servers are exactly the four the registrar holds
    And the zone has DeletionPolicy Retain, so deleting the stack never deletes the zone

  Scenario: The budget is imported, not replaced
    Given the monthly budget exists and was made by hand
    When the pipeline first deploys the budget stack
    Then the budget is imported with its limit, thresholds and subscribers unchanged
    And the alert address comes from a GitHub variable, never from Git

  Scenario: The deploy role stack becomes pipeline-managed
    Given the stack humorus-github-deploy was created by hand
    When the wider role template is applied once
    Then the same stack is updated in place and the OIDC provider and role are not replaced

  Scenario: A deploy stops if the name servers would change
    Given a deployed DNS stack
    When the zone's name servers differ from infra/expected-nameservers.json after a deploy
    Then the deploy fails loudly
```
